Welcome to CrackAddictz, the home of the most satisfying chiropractic adjustments and ASMR chiropractic content on YouTube.

We work with professional chiropractors globally to bring you explosive spine releases, deep muscle work, and the most intensive body adjustments available. Whether you're here for clinical pain relief education, deep ASMR tingles, or professional body restoration, our channel showcases the power of manual therapy and authentic spinal health.

From full-body alignment sessions to specialized nerve decompression, we provide an authoritative look at the art of the body reset.

New videos drop every Monday, Wednesday, Friday & Sunday at 3:00 PM
